title: Transitivity for one integral element in an arbitrary ambient algebra
statement: Let $R\to S\to B$ be unital homomorphisms of commutative rings, with the map $R\to B$ their composite. Assume every element of $S$ is integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. For any $x\in B$ integral over $S$, the element $x$ is integral over $R$. The ambient ring $B$ need not be integral over $S$; only this one element is assumed integral.
